# Tabletop Mechanics & Audited Interplays

This chapter documents the mechanical construction, modifier stacking legality, and rules interactions for **r31-K0 ("Reiko")**.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
from sr6core.character.ledger import get_log_totals
from sr6core.character.manager import CharacterManager
from sr6core.rules.engine import (
    get_weapon_attack_table,
    get_matrix_asdf_derivation_table,
    get_matrix_action_table,
    render_matrix_actions_markdown,
    render_multi_modifier_interactions,
    get_matrix_protocols_summary,
    render_sprite_stable
)
from sr6core.rules.modifiers import ModifierEngine

cm = CharacterManager()
_char = cm.get_character_data("reiko") or {}
attrs = _char.get("attributes", {})
log_totals = get_log_totals(["core/character_log.qmd", "core/character_purchases.qmd"])

SUBMERSION_GRADE = log_totals.get("Submersion_Grade", 8)
edge_storage_mtoc = 5
edge_storage_total = SUBMERSION_GRADE + edge_storage_mtoc

matrix_summary = get_matrix_protocols_summary("reiko")
active_asdf = matrix_summary.get("asdf", {})
ACTIVE_A = active_asdf.get("attack", 7)
ACTIVE_S = active_asdf.get("sleaze", 9)
ACTIVE_D = active_asdf.get("data_processing", 7)
ACTIVE_F = active_asdf.get("firewall", 9)
active_asdf_str = matrix_summary.get("asdf_str", "A:7 S:9 D:7 F:9")
full_def_hits = matrix_summary.get("full_defense_hits", 8)
full_def_pool = matrix_summary.get("full_defense_pool", 34)

RESONANCE = int(attrs.get("resonance", 8))
focus_mods = ModifierEngine.get_focus_modifiers(_char, "resonance")
RESONANCE_FOCUS = sum(m.value for m in focus_mods) if focus_mods else 4
std_def_pool = ACTIVE_F + RESONANCE + RESONANCE_FOCUS
std_def_hits = std_def_pool // 4
```

### Mechanical Construction & Citations

1. **Red Fox Lasers (Twin Eye-Mounts)**:
   * **Source**: *Firing Squad*, p. 44 / p. 116 (Energy Weapons) & *Double Clutch*, p. 143 (Link-Firing).
   * **Mounting Stability**: Built into cybernetic eye mounts / anthrodrone head assembly, granting **+2 AR** across all active ranges (*Firing Squad*, p. 112).
   * **Smartlink Integration**: Smartlink grants **+2 AR** (*SR6 Core*, p. 260); network coordination via Master Tactical Operations Commlink (M-TOC II) adds an additional **+1 AR** (*Firing Squad*, p. 90).
   * **Link-Firing Array**: Firing both emitters simultaneously adds **+2 DV** and **+1 AR**, costing 1 Major and 1 Minor action for the attack (*Double Clutch*, p. 143).

2. **Tesla Coil (Cyberarm Forearm Sprayer)**:
   * **Source**: *Body Shop*, p. 49 & *SR6 Core*, pp. 117–118 (Exotic Ranged / Spray Attack).
   * **Discharge Cones & Firing Modes**:
     * *Straight Stream*: Direct beam against the first target along a 20-meter line of fire. Standard base damage (`5S(e)`) and range profile (`10/12*`).
     * *Wobbly Cone*: Arc discharging across an $8.58^\circ$ cone (3 meters wide at 20m). Modifies attack by **+2 AR** (`12/14*`) and **-1 DV** (`4S(e)`). Affects all targets in the cone.
     * *Sweeping Arc*: Wide electrical discharge across a $28.07^\circ$ cone (10 meters wide at 20m). Modifies attack by **+4 AR** (`14/16*`) and **-3 DV** (`2S(e)`). Affects all targets in the cone.
   * **Wild Die Acceleration**: When executing a Wobbly or Sweeping discharge, Reiko may substitute one normal die with a **Wild Die** to accelerate stream speed (*SR6 Core*, p. 118).

3. **Amalgam Cestas (Anti-Spirit CQC)**:
   * **Source**: *Scotophobia*, p. 181 (Grey Mana Technology & Exotic Alloys).
   * **Overcoming Immunity to Normal Weapons (ItNW)**: Against materialized spirits or critters possessing ItNW, the entity's Essence-based Hardened Armor is treated as **normal armor** rather than hardened armor. Armor dice do not automatically convert to automatic hits, permitting mundane physical penetration without weapon foci (*Scotophobia*, p. 181).

## 2. Matrix Attributes, Defense Umbrella & Network Protocols{#matrix-attributes}

Reiko's base point-buy Living Persona ASDF is **`3 / 5 / 3 / 5`**. She gains **+6** from Sprite Symbiosis with Taz (`+3 / +2 / +1 / +0`), **+1** Data Processing from *Toolbox*, **+1** Firewall from *Encryption*, and **+8** from her Resonance (`+1 / +2 / +2 / +3`), for a raw total of **+16**. Under SR6 AI rules (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 116–120), Matrix ASDF attributes represent the intrinsic physical and mental characteristics of Digital Intelligences and are subject to the standard **+4 Augmented Attribute Limit**, bringing her active array to **`7 / 9 / 7 / 9`** (`Attack 7, Sleaze 9, Data Processing 7, Firewall 9`).

## 5. Complex Mechanical Interplays Specific to Reiko

### I. Inhabited Anthrodrone Override & Augmented Limits
* **Source**: *Hack & Slash*, pp. 116–124 (AI & Emergent Intelligences) & *SR6 Core*, p. 194 (Sprite Power *Override*).
* **Pilot Replacement**: When inhabiting her Shiawase Man-at-Arms anthrodrone, Reiko executes the Sprite Power *Override* (or her intrinsic AI pilot core) to substitute her Resonance rating (`{python} RESONANCE`) for the drone's Pilot rating. The **Designer** quality (*Hack & Slash*, p. 119) adds another **+1** to the Pilot rating of any drone she designates as her Home Device (base Pilot **9** + **+4** Resonance Focus = **13**).
* **Augmented Limit (+4)**: As a Digital Intelligence, Reiko's Matrix ASDF attributes are treated as personal attributes subject to the standard **+4 Augmented Attribute Limit** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 116).

### II. Edge Storage Capacity Stacking
* **Source**: *Double Clutch*, p. 124 (M-TOC II Network Host) & *Hack & Slash*, p. 120 (Echo: Transcendent Network).
* **Construction**:
  * Master Tactical Operations Commlink (M-TOC II): **5 Edge** storage capacity.
  * Transcendent Network Echo: Grants Edge storage equal to current **Submersion Grade** (`{python} SUBMERSION_GRADE`).
  * **Total Storage**: **`{python} edge_storage_total` Edge points** (`{python} edge_storage_mtoc` M-TOC II + `{python} SUBMERSION_GRADE` Submersion Grade).

### III. Sprite Symbiosis, Resonance Focus & Data Structure Exclusivity
* **Source**: *SR6 Core*, pp. 190–193, *Hack & Slash*, pp. 70–71 & *Shadowrun Missions Guide v2.4*, pp. 7, 39.
* **Single Active Data Structure Rule**: Under *SRMG v2.4*, an Emergent Intelligence can only actively use **one** data structure at a time. Reiko keeps her **Rating 4 Resonance Focus** active (+4 dice to all Resonance tests, passive, 0 Fading) and leaves the **Rating 4 Oracle** dormant inside the physical foundation of her Sanctuary Host (`~`) aboard the Sky Commander.
* **Fading Mitigation**: As a Technoshaman, Reiko mitigates fading from tasking. All compiling and decompiling actions reduce FV by 2 (*Hack & Slash*, p. 131). **Sprite Conduit** allows her to add her Submersion Grade (`{python} SUBMERSION_GRADE`) in dice to Fading Resistance tests from compiling and registering (`WIL 6 + CHA 4 + SUB 8 = 18d6`).

### IV. Home Device & Sanctuary Host Architecture
* **Source**: *Hack & Slash*, pp. 124, 128 (Foundation Hosts & AI Home Devices).
* **Active Venue Configuration**: Reiko designates her active inhabited anthrodrone (`Shiawase Man-at-Arms`) as her Home Device, granting **+1 Pilot** (*Designer*), **+1 Sensor** (flexible Home Device attribute boost), **+2 Noise Reduction**, and **+4 effective Matrix DR for Edge comparisons** (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 119, 124).
* **The Sanctuary Host (`~`)**: A Rating 2 Foundation Host compiled within the Deep Matrix (housed on the Federated-Boeing Sky Commander alongside the M-TOC Mark II and dormant Oracle R4 data structure). Its back quartz sliding glass door opens into a permanent un-insulated tear into the Holy Wild glade in the Deep Foundation (*Hack & Slash*, p. 128).

### III. Vector Thrust Flight Telemetry: Acceleration, Top Speed & Piloting Thresholds

Under SR6 vehicle movement (*SR6 Core*, pp. 199–200), vehicle distance per round is calculated as:
$$\text{Distance Traveled (m)} = \text{Starting Speed} + \frac{1}{2}(\text{Acceleration})$$
$$\text{Ending Speed (m/round)} = \text{Starting Speed} + \text{Acceleration}$$

The base Handling test threshold is equal to the vehicle's **Handling rating (4)**. For every full **Speed Interval (50 m/round)** passed, the driver incurs a cumulative **-1 dice pool penalty** to all Piloting tests and vehicle-mounted weapon attacks (*SR6 Core*, p. 199).

The table below contrasts standard full-throttle vector acceleration against **Nitro Boost** acceleration round-by-round from a stationary hover ($0\text{ m/round}$) to Top Speed ($300\text{ m/round}$ / $360\text{ km/h}$ / $223.7\text{ mph}$):

| Combat Round | Standard Mode (ACC 25 m/rnd)<br>Start $\rightarrow$ End Speed (Dist / Total) | Standard Mode<br>Piloting Threshold & Penalty | Nitro Boost Mode (ACC 50 m/rnd, Wild Die)<br>Start $\rightarrow$ End Speed (Dist / Total) | Nitro Boost Mode<br>Piloting Threshold & Penalty |

#### Operational Takeaways:
* **Nitro Boost Acceleration Advantage**: Triggering Nitro Boost (Minor Action) cuts the time to achieve Top Speed (300 m/round / 360.0 km/h / 223.7 mph) **in half**—from **12 combat rounds (36 seconds)** down to **6 combat rounds (18 seconds)**, while covering **900 meters** vs. 450 meters.
* **Braking & High-G Deceleration**: Per *Double Clutch* (p. 135), Nitro Boost's industrial capacitor applies equally to deceleration, permitting Reiko to bleed up to **50 m/round** (60.0 km/h / 37.3 mph) in a single combat round to avoid crashes.
* **Inhabited Piloting Pool**: When Reiko inhabits her Man-at-Arms, she rolls Piloting (or autosoft) + Reaction / Pilot Override (13). Even at maximum Speed Interval penalty (-5 dice), her baseline AI pilot pool comfortably exceeds the Handling 4 threshold.

### IV. Queued Vector Thrust Subsystem Upgrades (Mechanical Plan Roadmap)

As documented in [mechanical_plan.md](file:///c:/GitHub/sr6-core/characters/reiko/reference/mechanical_plan.md), secondary propulsion systems possess **dedicated subsystem mod slots** that do not consume primary chassis slots. The following upgrades are queued in Priority 2:

1. **Improved Acceleration (2 Ranks)** (*DC*, p. 134):
   * Consumes 2 dedicated subsystem slots (15,000¥ DIY).
   * Adds +60% to base acceleration: **$25 \rightarrow 33 \rightarrow \mathbf{41\text{ m/round}}$** ($49.2\text{ km/h}$ / $\approx 30.6\text{ mph}$ burst in 3 seconds).
   * *Nitro Boost Synergy*: Under Nitro Boost, acceleration jumps to **$82\text{ m/round}$** ($98.4\text{ km/h}$ / $\approx 61.1\text{ mph}$ burst in 3 seconds), reaching 300 m/round ($360.0\text{ km/h}$ / $223.7\text{ mph}$) in under **4 rounds (12 seconds)**!
2. **Top Speed Increase (3 Ranks)** (*DC*, p. 138):
   * Consumes 3 dedicated subsystem slots (12,000¥ DIY).
   * Adds +60% to base Top Speed: **$300 \rightarrow \mathbf{480\text{ m/round}}$** ($576.0\text{ km/h}$ / $\approx 357.9\text{ mph}$ / Mach 0.47).
   * *Combined Performance*: With both upgrades and Nitro Boost active, Reiko will accelerate from stationary to high-speed subsonic cruise (480 m/round / 576.0 km/h / ~357.9 mph / Mach 0.47) in just **6 combat rounds (18 seconds)**, covering 1,440 meters.
